name: io.github.mainwp/mainwp-mcp
title: MainWP
description: Manage WordPress sites in MainWP from AI tools, with approval before destructive changes by default.

environmentVariables.name: MAINWP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of your MainWP Dashboard, such as https://dashboard.example.com

environmentVariables.name: MAINWP_USER
environmentVariables.description: WordPress username of the Dashboard administrator (the login name, not the display name)

environmentVariables.name: MAINWP_APP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: WordPress Application Password for that user, not their login password
